description.ja: 伝 説 の 白 き 秘 宝
description.en: Legendary White Treasure

description.ja: キ ッ ト 化 の 刻 ―
description.en: The moment of kitization

description.ja: 『聖戦士ダンバイン』より、
description.en: From "Sacred Warrior Dunbine"

description.ja: バランバランの白き秘宝と謳われるオーラ・バトラー“サーバイン”をＨＧシリーズで完全新規造形で再現。
description.en: The aura battler "Servine", who is said to be the white treasure of Baranbaran, is reproduced with a completely new model in the HG series.

description.ja: 最新フォーマットによる造形とギミックを再現し、出渕裕氏描きおろしの新規シールドが付属。
description.en: The model and gimmick are reproduced using the latest format, and a new seal drawn by Yutaka Izubuchi is included.

description.ja: ●　完全新規造形、最新フォーマットで徹底再現
description.en: ●Completely new model, thoroughly reproduced in the latest format

description.ja: メカと生物の様相をあわせ持つサーバインの特徴的なフォルム、生物感を意識した反りのある造形と洗練されたシャープな造形を最新の造形技術で再現。
description.en: The characteristic form of the Servine, which has both mechanical and biological aspects, is reproduced with the latest modeling technology, with a curved shape that is conscious of the creature's appearance, and a sophisticated and sharp shape.

description.ja: 頭部のエンブレムをはじめ、首襟元や肩部、腰部、鞘などにあしらわれた紋様を精密かつ細やかなパーツ分割により完全再現。
description.en: The emblem on the head, as well as the patterns on the neck, shoulders, waist, sheath, etc., are completely reproduced by precise and detailed parts division.

description.ja: 頭部の瞳はメカの様相と生物の様相のデザインをパーツの選択で再現可能。
description.en: The eyes of the head can be recreated with mechanical and biological designs by selecting parts.

description.ja: ●　特徴的な機体カラーをパーツごとに分割し、成形色で再現。
description.en: ● The characteristic aircraft color is divided into parts and reproduced with molded colors.

description.ja: ホワイト、パープル、レッド、ゴールド、シルバー、グレーと多彩な成形色を採用し、サーバインの機体カラーを細やかに再現。
description.en: Adopting a variety of molding colors such as white, purple, red, gold, silver, and gray, the body color of Servine is reproduced in detail.

description.ja: 羽には偏光パール素材を用いたクリアパーツを採用。
description.en: Clear parts made of polarized pearl material are used for the wings.

description.ja: ●　ＨＧ最新フォーマットの可動性能
description.en: ● Mobility performance of the latest HG format

description.ja: 最新の可動ギミックを全身に搭載。優麗にして柔軟なポージングが可能。
description.en: Equipped with the latest movable gimmicks throughout the body. Possible for elegant and flexible poses.

description.ja: 腕部
description.en: arm

description.ja: 肘関節に２重関節を採用し、二の腕と前腕部にロール回転軸を搭載。フレキシブルな可動を実現。
description.en: A double joint is used in the elbow joint, and roll rotation axes are installed in the upper arm and forearm. Realizes flexible movement.

description.ja: 脚部
description.en: leg

description.ja: 膝関節にも2重関節を採用。また趾（あしゆび）部はボールジョイントにより独立可動を実現。
description.en: Double joints are also used in the knee joints. In addition, the toes can be moved independently using ball joints.

description.ja: オーラコンバーター
description.en: aura converter

description.ja: 上下左右のロール軸を搭載。羽の展開が可能。
description.en: Equipped with up, down, left and right roll axes. Wings can be expanded.

description.ja: ●　オーラソード
description.en: ● Aura Sword

description.ja: 刀身部と柄をパーツ分割で色分け再現。
description.en: The blade and handle are reproduced in different colors by dividing the parts.

description.ja: 鞘の紋様部分もパーツ分割により細やかに再現。鞘はオーラコンバーターへ懸架可能。
description.en: The pattern on the sheath is also finely reproduced by dividing the parts. The scabbard can be suspended on the aura converter.

description.ja: ●　出渕裕氏デザイン サーバイン用シールド、立体化！
description.en: ● Seal for server-in designed by Yutaka Izubuchi, three-dimensional!

description.ja: メカニックデザイナー　出渕裕氏描き下ろしのサーバイン用シールドを新規造形で立体化。
description.en: The Seal for Servaine drawn by mechanical designer Hiroshi Izubuchi is now three-dimensional with new modeling.

description.ja: 表面のレリーフは、パーツ分割により色分け再現。
description.en: The relief on the surface is reproduced in different colors by dividing the parts.
